rules.name: canBearChild
actions: data.put('canBearChild',  fhirPath.extractValue(Patient, "Patient.active and Patient.gender = 'female' and ((Patient.birthDate <= today() - 11 'years') and (Patient.birthDate >= today() - 49 'years'))"))

rules.name: diagnosisOfLastConsultation
actions: var allDiagnoses = ''; for (var condition: data.get('diagnoses')) { if((data.get('latestQREncounter')).equals(fhirPath.extractValue(condition, 'Condition.encounter.reference.substring(10)'))){ allDiagnoses = allDiagnoses + fhirPath.extractValue(condition, 'Condition.code.coding.display') + ', '; }}; data.put('diagnosisOfLastConsultation', allDiagnoses.replaceAll(',\\s*$', ''));
